instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. In a sunny outdoor park with green grass and trees, a woman in a black beanie and red t-shirt (R4) stands in the foreground right, her body angled away as she turns her head back to laugh joyfully. Behind her on the left, a bald man in a dark blue t-shirt (R1) stands in the background, smiling warmly as he watches her. The scene is illuminated by bright, warm natural sunlight filtering through the trees, creating a shallow depth of field that softly blurs the background.
